text:
natalie (partnerships): Hey team — OpenFlux asked for permission to collect minimal telemetry for model quality in marketplace bundles. Quick sync on what we can/should allow? cc @sarah (legal) @aj (eng) @marco (privacy)

sarah (legal): Need opt-in, retention cap, no PII, delete-on-request, and a statement that prompts are never shared. Also require hashed model provenance + signed manifest.

aj (eng): We can emit counters + latency + error rates. Avoid raw prompt text. Example payload: ```{ \"model_id\": \"openflux-13B\", \"latency_ms\": 120, \"tokens_gen\": 256, \"error_rate\": 0.02 }```

marco (privacy): +1 on no raw prompts or user ids. Pseudonymized client_id is OK. Recommend retention = 90 days default, configurable per customer.

emily (partnerships): From marketplace POV partners want telemetry to show perf and to feed recommendation signals. Can we give them an agreed schema + contract snippet?

sarah (legal): I'll draft a telemetry addendum covering permitted fields, hashing policy, retention windows, deletion workflow, audit rights, and acceptance language. Need vendor contact for signature.

vendor-openflux: Thanks — we only want anonymized telemetry to optimize quantization and routing. We can provide SHA256 model hash and will not include prompt content or PII.

aj (eng): Also: manifest signature so bundles can't be swapped. Fields: `manifest_hash`, `signature` (base64). We'll validate signature in ingestion.

natalie (partnerships): Any export/redistribution implications if the partner requests downloads? We should ensure marketplace bundles default to hosted-only unless license allows redistribution.

sarah (legal): Correct — include a redistribution flag and geoblocking checkbox. If upstream license forbids rehosting, our marketplace must enforce hosted-only offering and surface that clearly.

emily (partnerships): UI ask: add a vendor checkbox: 'I confirm telemetry will not include PII or user prompt content' and link to the telemetry addendum in the onboarding flow.

aj (eng): Infra notes: ingestion endpoint should require `X-Telemetry-Schema: 1.0` header, shipper token, and be rate-limited. No raw text fields accepted.

marco (privacy): Also add optional differential-privacy toggle in the contract and reference to our DPA. Good to offer DP as a best-practice for partners.

vendor-openflux: We can emit `dp_noisy=true` when DP is enabled. Please share manifest template + telemetry sample and we'll adapt.

natalie (partnerships): Great. @sarah can you share a first draft by EOD? @aj can you post a manifest + telemetry example here so vendor has something concrete?

aj (eng): Dropped sample manifest + telemetry below:
```
{
  "manifest":{
    "model_id":"openflux-13B",
    "manifest_hash":"sha256:abc123def456...",
    "signature":"base64:MEUCIQ...",
    "license":"cc-by-4.0",
    "bundle_type":"hosted-only"
  },
  "telemetry":{
    "schema":"1.0",
    "latency_ms":110,
    "tokens":200,
    "dp_noisy":false
  }
}
```

sarah (legal): LGTM as a starting point. I'll add the retention numbers (90/180 options) and a deletion SLA (72 hours for manual request, automated for DPA clauses).

natalie (partnerships): Thanks all. Next steps: Sarah drafts addendum, Aj + Marco finalize schema and infra checks, then we send to OpenFlux for sign-off. I'll schedule a 30m sync with OpenFlux tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar:
